Sam —

Quick technical summary as requested: the two levers that typically matter most for a personalization workload are (1) quantization/weight compression to reduce GPU memory and cost per token and (2) prefix/KV caching to lower effective per-request compute for repeated contexts (recommend a small pilot for cache hit patterns). If you're hitting sustained 1k+ qps we suggest dedicated capacity; otherwise hosted with aggressive batching and cache policies is more economical.

Happy to keep this high-level while you reallocate resources; we can convert these bullets into a one-pager for product if that would be useful in FY28 planning decks.

—Karthik
